run_reward_function: run the reward_function to compute L1 and L2 distance-based rewards from trajectory paths
create_reward_from_paths: create a rewards array from observation paths using negative L1 and L2 distance metrics
test_reward_function: test the reward_function with sample trajectory observations and verify reward shape and values
refactor_reward_function: refactor the reward_function to support alternative distance metrics beyond L1 and L2
summarize_reward_function: summarize the reward_function that computes point mass rewards from agent and target positions
